title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 40
description: Ten questions on Genesis 40: the dreams of Pharaoh's cup bearer and baker, and Joseph's interpretations.

questions.text: Which two officers of Pharaoh were put in custody?
questions.explanation: Pharaoh was angry with his two officers, the chief cup bearer and the chief baker, and put them in custody.

answers.text: The chief cup bearer and the chief baker
The chief cup bearer and the chief cook
The chief baker and the captain of the guard

questions.text: Who assigned the two officers to Joseph?
questions.explanation: The captain of the guard assigned them to Joseph, and he took care of them.

questions.text: To whom did Joseph say interpretations belong?
questions.explanation: Joseph said to them, "Don't interpretations belong to God? Please tell it to me."

questions.text: How many branches were on the vine in the cup bearer's dream?
questions.explanation: The cup bearer said that in the vine were three branches.

questions.text: What did the cup bearer do with the grapes in his dream?
questions.explanation: He took the grapes, pressed them into Pharaoh's cup and gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand.

questions.text: What did Joseph ask the cup bearer to do when things went well for him?
questions.explanation: Joseph asked him to remember him, show him kindness and make mention of him to Pharaoh, to bring him out of that house.

answers.text: Remember him and mention him to Pharaoh
Send word to his father in Canaan
Bring him wine from Pharaoh's table
Punish his brothers for selling him

questions.text: What ate the baked food out of the uppermost basket in the baker's dream?
questions.explanation: The baker said that the birds ate the baked food out of the basket on his head.

questions.text: What special day was the third day?
questions.explanation: The third day was Pharaoh's birthday, and he made a feast for all his servants.

answers.text: The day of the new moon

questions.text: What happened to the chief baker?
questions.explanation: Pharaoh hanged the chief baker, as Joseph had interpreted to them.

answers.text: He was restored to his office
He was sent home to his land
He stayed in prison for many years

questions.text: How did the chief cup bearer treat Joseph after he was restored?
questions.explanation: The chief cup bearer didn't remember Joseph, but forgot him.

answers.text: He told Pharaoh about him at once
He brought him out of prison
